quality.review_scope: Complete author text and actual visual reading of main pp.1–5 and SI pp.1–4; synthesis variants, electrode preparation, controls, structural results and electrochemical contexts retained. External full cited procedures and unprinted numerical curves excluded.
missing_fields: All five main and four SI pages were read as text and faithful page images; cited external full procedures remain outside the inspected local source.
Physical batch joins, unprinted curve values, atomic coordinates and unreported quantities are not reconstructed.
Source figures and qualified reference identities do not establish measured atomic geometry or training eligibility.
Electrode area, illumination irradiance/beam geometry, gas-flow rate and solution volume are not reported.
conflicts: Figure S2 is captioned j–E, but its ordinate is current i in µA. Main Figure 3 shows j in µA/cm²; no area or conversion between those ordinates is inferred.
